headlines.title: BofA Slashes Marvell Target by 44% After Lumentum Deal
headlines.summary: The firm cut its rating to Neutral, citing dilution, regulatory uncertainty and potential customer conflicts from the proposed acquisition.

headlines.title: What Is Bank of America (BAC) Signaling With Its New Board And Las Vegas Chief?
headlines.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) appointed Wendy Franco as president of the Las Vegas market, overseeing local business and community efforts. Jim Fitterling, chair and CEO of Dow Inc., and Bill Thomas, former KPMG International CEO, joined Bank of America’s Board of Directors. Fitterling and Thomas bring experience in technology, AI, global operations and corporate governance from large industrial and professional services organizations.

headlines.title: AML Settlement Charge Might Change The Case For Investing In Bank of America (BAC)
headlines.summary: Bank of America reported weaker than expected Q3 2026 results after recording a US$1.2b regulatory settlement charge tied to anti money laundering oversight issues, which has been followed by multiple class action lawsuits focused on alleged compliance failures.

headlines.title: A lasting AI sell-off is one of the biggest risks to the economy, BofA warns
headlines.summary: With stocks at a record share of household wealth, a lasting AI correction has become an economic risk, not just a market one.

headlines.title: ETFs Bought $24.4 Million of Bank of America (BAC) on Oct. 29
headlines.summary: ETFs bought $24.4 million of Bank of America stock on Thursday, Oct. 29.

description: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. Bank of America Corporation was founded in 1784 and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
